subject.title: fix(ssh-verify): preserve active cooldown entries during prune

question: When more than 512 SSH cooldowns are simultaneously active, should the gateway preserve the current hard cache bound or adopt a different explicit bounded overflow policy that favors active entries?
rationale: The requested behavior and the existing hard-size invariant conflict in the all-active case; no one-line implementation can guarantee both without defining which cooldown entries may be retained or lost.

options.title: Keep the hard bound
options.body: Reject this guard and retain bounded eviction unless a demonstrated user-impact case establishes that current capacity behavior is incorrect.

options.title: Adopt a new bounded policy
options.body: Define and test a deterministic policy for capacity overflow, such as admission control or prioritized retention, without allowing unbounded growth.

recommendation.title: Keep the hard bound
recommendation.body: Reject this guard and retain bounded eviction unless a demonstrated user-impact case establishes that current capacity behavior is incorrect.

likelyOwner.reason: A gateway-area owner needs to decide the cache contract because the supplied review context contains no attributable current-main owner.
